These documents were assembled from a local Bitcoin Puzzle research project. Preparing this snapshot does not establish legal authorship or assign a license on behalf of contributors. A repository license has not yet been chosen; no LICENSE file has been created.

The reports cite historical software, publications, standards, and public blockchain data. Their authorship and terms are not replaced by those of a future repository. Third-party codebases are not copied here.

The public solution table comes from roadhero/Bitcoin-Puzzle-Info; its URL, download timestamp, and SHA-256 are recorded in the source metadata. Published Puzzle solutions are not secrets of the working-directory owner's personal wallet.

The package is intended for reading and evaluating conclusions. Contents and transformations · Translation provenance.
